about.seoDescription: How Referral Code Exchange works, who issues the rewards, and what happens to codes that stop working.
about.heading: About
about.noRewardsBody: Rewards come from each service — streaming, shopping, delivery, rides and so on. All this site does is connect people who have a referral code with people who are about to sign up. It never handles rewards, points or money.
about.expiredTitle: What happens to codes that stop working
about.expiredBody: Three layers: manual review when a code is submitted, automatic removal when the code's own expiry date passes, and user reports. After copying a code, come back and tap "It worked" or "Didn't work" — codes that collect enough failure reports are removed automatically.
about.rankingBody: The order is drawn again on every page view. Codes with a higher success rate carry more weight, but codes that have already received a lot of exposure are weighted down so newly shared codes get a turn. Seeing a different order from someone else is normal.

support.seoDescription: Frequently asked questions, contact details and account help.
support.heading: Support
support.lead: Most questions are answered below. If yours is not, email us.

code.q: The code I copied was rejected
code.a: Codes are case-sensitive. Paste the whole string exactly, with no extra spaces. If it still fails, go back and tap "Did not work" — enough reports and the code is taken down automatically.

expired.q: Why are there fewer codes than yesterday?
expired.a: Codes carry an expiry date and come down automatically when they pass it, as do codes reported as dead too often. The catalogue only keeps what still works.

rewards.a: Rewards are issued by each service, not by us — we never handle rewards, points or money. Check that service’s own terms for timing and conditions.

account.q: What if I see something objectionable?
account.a: Tap "⋯" on any code in the app to report the content or block the person who shared it. Blocked people’s codes stop appearing for you. Every code is reviewed by a human before it goes live.

support.contactBody: If your answer is not above, email us. Include the service name and the code itself so we can find it faster.
support.accountBody: You can delete your account without installing the app.
